items.quote: - [x] **WIRE-01**: Each of the six query candidates (naive, bypass, hybrid, local, global, hipporag) can be resolved by at least one production §18.4 selector without a promote.
- [x] **WIRE-02**: parse_wiring reports a named violation whenever a top-level provides entry or evidence_position.node names a node missing from the wiring's nodes.

- [x] **WIRE-03**: ResponseEnvelope.stop_reason and degradation_reason, and the same two fields in the non-debug /trace/resolve output, never contain an internal node id, a part name@version, or an internal exception class name.
- [x] **WIRE-04**: When no provides node produced a completion (a failed or partial run), ResponseEnvelope.depth_label is null instead of 'stage'.

- [x] **WIRE-05**: Every refusal the runner raises before dispatch, and every cyclic-wiring outcome, reaches REST as a structured SeamRefusalError subclass with a named type and fields, never as an unstructured 500.
- [x] **WIRE-06**: parse_wiring returns a ValidationReport and never raises for a malformed document.
- [x] **WIRE-07**: Execution placement has one source. validator/depth.py no longer defines derive_execution_mode;
- [x] **WIRE-08**: A guard fires only on the value it declares.
- [x] **WIRE-09**: The LightRAG local and global arms' keyword fall-through guards (ll_keywords_empty_fallthrough, hl_keywords_empty_fallthrough) are handled in one of two ways.
Every node in the wiring has exactly one NodeTrace in the run record, including nodes the TaskGroup cancelled because a sibling failed and nodes in batches that were never scheduled.
NodeTrace fields report what was measured. An execution_mode field is stamped on every node (in-process, subprocess and so on) on both the success and the refusal path.
RunRecord identity and persistence describe the run accurately.
SeamEvent records are correct. A mutating node whose execution raised gets outcome 'failed', not 'halted'; 'halted' stays reserved for budget halts.
Engine internal paths fail by name and open the correct stores.
The four advanced query members (embedding, predicates, profile_ref, formal_query) are permanently refused for this contract version
Each refusal type that shipped wirings can only partly reach has a test that pins where it can occur.
The runner exposes no unused scheduling or budget API.
